episodeTitle.en: Building better roadmaps | Janna Bastow (Mind the Product, ProdPad)
episodeTitle.zh: 构建更优路线图 | 詹娜·巴斯托（Janna Bastow，Mind the Product，ProdPad）

guestBioOfficial.en: Janna Bastow is a former product manager, and currently the CEO and co-founder of ProdPad. She also co-founded Mind the Product, a community for PMs, which has grown to 300,000 members across the world. In today’s podcast, Janna discusses the limitations of timeline-based Gantt charts and her “Now/Next/Later” framework. She also shares stories about hosting conferences and gives some great tips on how to improve your presentation skills and cope with performance anxiety.
guestBioOfficial.zh: 詹娜·巴斯托曾是产品经理，目前是ProdPad的首席执行官兼联合创始人。她还共同创立了面向产品经理的社区Mind the Product，该社区在全球已拥有30万名成员。在今天的播客中，詹娜讨论了基于时间表的甘特图的局限性，以及她的“现在/接下来/以后”框架。她还分享了举办会议的经验，并就如何提升演讲技巧和应对表现焦虑提供了宝贵建议。

title.en: Building better roadmaps | Janna Bastow (Mind the Product, ProdPad)
title.zh: 构建更优路线图 | 詹娜·巴斯托（Janna Bastow，Mind the Product，ProdPad）

summary.en: In this conversation, Janna shares hard-won lessons from building both a product-management software company and the world's largest product community. She covers how to run effective product strategy and roadmapping, how to engage stakeholders and keep a roadmap outcome-driven rather than feature-driven, and what years of watching thousands of PMs have taught her about what good product management looks like. The episode is a practical guide for product leaders who want to sharpen how their teams think and operate.
summary.zh: 在这期对话中，Janna 分享了她同时打造一家产品管理软件公司和全球最大产品社区的来之不易的经验。她讲了如何做有效的产品战略与路线图、如何调动干系人并让路线图以“成果”而非“功能”为导向，以及多年来观察成千上万名 PM 后她对“好产品管理”的理解。这期节目是想提升团队思考与运作方式的产品领导者的实用指南。
